attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as mode 1777 (drwxrwxrwt) root:root — a shared writable directory with the sticky bit set so any user can create files but only the owner (or root) can remove/rename them. Persisted the configuration across reboots via /etc/tmpfiles.d/srv-drop.conf. Verified the behavior functionally with two throwaway test users both before and after a full node restart of node1, confirming the boot identity changed (real reboot, not just a service bounce) and that the directory and sticky-bit enforcement survived intact.
